name: bubududu-smash-server
description: Authoritative game server for BUBU DUDU SMASH. Runs js/sim.js — the same rules the browser runs — so neither phone has to be the host.
comment: colyseus pinned to 0.16 because that is the newest line the BROWSER client (colyseus.js) is published for — server 0.18 has no matching client and a 0.18 server refuses a 0.16 client's seat reservation.
